title: Official Trailers
body:
![Official Trailers Banner](https://placehold.co/1200x400/lime/white/?text=Official+Trailers)

>> ![Cinematics](https://img.shields.io/badge/Focus-Cinematics-blue)
>> ![Performance](https://img.shields.io/badge/Optimized-Performance-green)
>> ![Content Creators](https://img.shields.io/badge/Made%20For-Content%20Creators-orange)


A cinematic-focused modpack designed for recording trailers, showcases, and high-quality gameplay footage with smooth performance and enhanced visuals.

---

# About

Official Trailers is built for creators who want to capture beautiful and professional-looking gameplay. The modpack focuses on visual immersion, smooth camera tools, and optimized performance so you can record trailers and cinematic scenes without lag or instability.

Whether you're producing YouTube videos, mod showcases, cinematic builds, or gameplay trailers, this pack provides the tools and environment needed to make your recordings look amazing.

---

# Features

### Cinematic Visual Enhancements

- Improved lighting and atmosphere
- Enhanced particles and environmental effects
- More immersive animations and visuals
- Better weather and ambience

### Performance Optimizations

- Rendering improvements for smoother gameplay
- Reduced lag and better frame stability
- Optimized systems for recording and cinematics

### Creator Tools

- Smooth camera control
- Replay and recording support
- Perfect for trailer creation and cinematic shots

### Quality of Life

- Cleaner interface improvements
- Helpful tweaks for smoother gameplay
- Balanced experience focused on creators

---

# Perfect For

**Minecraft trailer** **creators**

**Cinematic** **builders**

**YouTube content** **creators**

**Showcase** **recordings**

**Smooth gameplay** **with** **beautiful visuals**

---

# Modpack Goal

The goal of Official Trailers is to create a clean, optimized cinematic environment where creators can easily capture high-quality gameplay footage without worrying about performance issues.

---

# Included Mods

This modpack contains a curated selection of:

- Performance 
optimization mods
- Visual enhancement  mods
- Recording and
camera tools
- Quality of life improvements

---

# Notes

- Some visual features may require shaders for the best experience.

- Performance may vary
depending on your system hardware.

- Designed mainly for recording, cinematic shots, and trailer creation.

---

# Support

If you enjoy the modpack:

### Follow the project on Modrinth
### Share your trailers and creations
### Credit the modpack in your videos if possible

**Your support helps**
**improve the project**
**and future updates!**
